-- Calculate percentage change for each attribute value
WITH before_sales AS (
    SELECT region, SUM(sales) as sales FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date <= '2020-06-08' GROUP BY region
),
after_sales AS (
    SELECT region, SUM(sales) as sales FROM cleaned_weekly_sales 
    WHERE calendar_year = 2020 AND week_date >= '2020-06-22' GROUP BY region
)
SELECT bs.region, bs.sales as before, asales.sales as after,
    (asales.sales - bs.sales) / bs.sales * 100 as pct_change
FROM before_sales bs
JOIN after_sales asales ON bs.region = asales.region
